{{Quote|Liar, liar! I'm sick and tired of all this whining! Tell us what we want to know right now, or I will gut you like a Rokarian dirt-fish!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]|<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />}}
A '''Rokarian dirt-fish''' was a species of fish. They were known to be gutted.<ref name="Cloak of Darkness" />

==Behind the scenes==
Subtitles on the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition Blu-ray]] incorrectly spelled it as "Rokaria'n dirt fish."<ref name="Clone Wars 1-5">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Seasons 1-5 Collector's Edition]]</ref>
